<a id="api-createS3CompatibleStorage"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `createS3CompatibleStorage`

Creates an unscoped private-upload, signed-URL storage adapter for R2 or S3.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-server/storage`, `@alneas/eaos-server/storage/s3-compatible`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function createS3CompatibleStorage(config: S3CompatibleStorageConfig): Promise<StorageAdapter>;
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | `S3CompatibleStorageConfig` | Yes | Provider configuration, credentials, and URL ceiling; see {@link S3CompatibleStorageConfig}. |

### Returns

`Promise<StorageAdapter>`

A frozen app-core adapter whose uploads reject public=true and whose URLs always use signatures within the configured ceiling.

### Remarks

Server-only: transport/signing stay in app-core and the host supplies secrets. Credentials are resolved once at construction. Signed access also works during a public-bucket migration but cannot close existing public URLs. Keep this unscoped adapter host-owned; give plugins createTenantS3CompatibleStorage. Constructing an adapter does not verify remote credentials or create a bucket.

### Errors and rejections

Rejects invalid provider, lifetime, bucket, account/region, endpoint, or empty credentials, and propagates credential callback/import/adapter construction errors. Subsequent operations propagate transport errors.

### Example

```typescript
import { createS3CompatibleStorage, readS3CompatibleStorageConfig } from "@alneas/eaos-server/storage/s3-compatible";
// The host provisions a private bucket and supplies the documented storage environment.
const config = readS3CompatibleStorageConfig();
if (!config) throw new Error("Storage is not configured");
const storage = await createS3CompatibleStorage(config);
// Retain storage in trusted server code; authorize requests before performing operations.
```


<a id="api-createTenantS3CompatibleStorage"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `createTenantS3CompatibleStorage`

Creates provider-backed storage isolated to a verified tenant/plugin scope.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-server/storage`, `@alneas/eaos-server/storage/s3-compatible`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function createTenantS3CompatibleStorage(config: S3CompatibleStorageConfig, options: TenantStorageOptions): Promise<StorageAdapter>;
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | `S3CompatibleStorageConfig` | Yes | Host provider configuration and credentials. |
| `options` | `TenantStorageOptions` | Yes | Trusted scope and live authorization; an omitted scope URL ceiling inherits config.maxUrlLifetimeSeconds, then 300. |

### Returns

`Promise<StorageAdapter>`

A frozen scoped adapter; see {@link createTenantStorage} for relative key and operation policy.

### Remarks

The provider ceiling also applies, so a larger scope ceiling cannot increase it. The host owns bucket provisioning and verified identity resolution.

### Errors and rejections

Rejects provider construction failures and invalid scope settings; operations propagate authorization, policy, and transport errors.

### Example

```typescript
import { createTenantS3CompatibleStorage, type S3CompatibleStorageConfig } from "@alneas/eaos-server/storage/s3-compatible";
import type { TenantStorageOptions } from "@alneas/eaos-server/storage";
export async function scopedStorage(config: S3CompatibleStorageConfig, trustedOptions: TenantStorageOptions) {
  return createTenantS3CompatibleStorage(config, trustedOptions);
}
```


<a id="api-createTenantStorage"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `createTenantStorage`

Wraps a storage adapter with tenant/plugin key isolation and per-operation authorization.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-server/storage`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function createTenantStorage(adapter: StorageAdapter, options: TenantStorageOptions): StorageAdapter;
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `adapter` | `StorageAdapter` | Yes | Host-owned transport/signing adapter; optional copy and move are exposed only when supported. |
| `options` | `TenantStorageOptions` | Yes | Trusted scope, authorization callback, and signed URL ceiling; see {@link TenantStorageOptions}. |

### Returns

`StorageAdapter`

A frozen adapter using relative keys while storing under tenants/{tenantId}/plugins/{pluginId}/; returned object keys and list cursors are scope-relative.

### Remarks

Keys cannot be absolute or contain traversal, empty segments, backslashes, percent escapes, control characters, query strings, or fragments. List permits an empty prefix and slash delimiter only. URLs default to a 300-second ceiling and remain usable until expiry after authorization changes. This wrapper supplies no persistence, locking, revocation, or transaction mechanism beyond the underlying adapter. The host must retain ownership of the unscoped adapter.

### Errors and rejections

Throws synchronously for invalid scope IDs or URL lifetime. Operations reject for invalid relative keys, denied access, public uploads, unsigned or overlong URLs, invalid cursors/delimiters, out-of-scope provider results, or propagated adapter/authorization errors.

### Example

```typescript
import { createTenantStorage, type StorageAdapter, type TenantStorageOptions } from "@alneas/eaos-server/storage";
export function pluginStorage(adapter: StorageAdapter, trustedOptions: TenantStorageOptions) {
  // Resolve scope and authorization from verified host identity, never request body IDs.
  return createTenantStorage(adapter, trustedOptions);
}
```


<a id="api-readS3CompatibleStorageConfig"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `readS3CompatibleStorageConfig`

Reads trimmed S3 or R2 configuration from a host environment map.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-server/storage`, `@alneas/eaos-server/storage/s3-compatible`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function readS3CompatibleStorageConfig(env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): S3CompatibleStorageConfig | null;
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | `Record<string, string \| undefined>` | No | Environment values; defaults to process.env. EAOS_STORAGE_PROVIDER selects s3/r2 case-insensitively. R2 uses R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_BUCKET, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and optional R2_ENDPOINT. S3 uses S3_BUCKET, S3_REGION, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID, S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, optional S3_ENDPOINT, and S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE (true or 1). EAOS_STORAGE_MAX_URL_SECONDS is converted with Number. |

### Returns

`S3CompatibleStorageConfig \| null`

Configuration, or null when the provider is absent/blank. This read does not fully validate values; creation validates provider settings.

### Remarks

Returned configuration contains secrets and belongs exclusively in trusted server code.

### Errors and rejections

If a selected provider lacks required nonblank values, or the provider is unsupported.

### Example

```typescript
import { readS3CompatibleStorageConfig } from "@alneas/eaos-server/storage/s3-compatible";
const config = readS3CompatibleStorageConfig();
console.log(config ? "Storage configured" : "Storage disabled");
```


<a id="api-S3CompatibleStorageConfig"></a>

## [TYPE] `S3CompatibleStorageConfig`

Selects R2 or S3 transport settings with host-held credentials and a signed URL ceiling.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-server/storage`, `@alneas/eaos-server/storage/s3-compatible`.

### Signature

```typescript
type S3CompatibleStorageConfig = Common & (({
    provider: 'r2';
} & Omit<R2StorageConfig, 'accessKeyId' | 'secretAccessKey' | 'publicUrl' | 'defaultExpiresIn'>) | ({
    provider: 's3';
} & Omit<S3StorageConfig, 'accessKeyId' | 'secretAccessKey' | 'defaultExpiresIn'>));
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| — | — | — | No call parameters. |

### Returns

Type declaration; no runtime value.

### Remarks

R2 requires a 32-hex-character accountId; S3 requires region. Both require a valid bucket name. Optional endpoints must be HTTPS URLs without credentials, query, or fragment. Provider-specific fields follow app-core storage configuration; public URLs are not configured by this factory.

### See also

createS3CompatibleStorage for a complete setup example.

### Public members

#### `provider`

Select Cloudflare R2 transport; accountId must be 32 hexadecimal characters and bucket/credentials must be configured.


#### `provider`

Select S3-compatible transport; a nonempty region and valid bucket/credentials are required, with optional HTTPS endpoint.

<a id="api-TenantStorageOptions"></a>

## [INTERFACE] `TenantStorageOptions`

Trusted tenant/plugin scope and per-operation authorization for [createTenantStorage](#api-createTenantStorage).

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-server/storage`.

### Signature

```typescript
interface TenantStorageOptions {
    tenantId: string;
    pluginId: string;
    authorize: (request: {
        tenantId: string;
        pluginId: string;
        operation: StorageOperation;
        keys: readonly string[];
    }) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
    maxUrlLifetimeSeconds?: number;
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tenantId` | `string` | Yes | Trusted tenant ID: 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting alphanumeric. It must come from verified server identity/configuration, never request body keys. |
| `pluginId` | `string` | Yes | Trusted plugin ID: 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. |
| `authorize` | `(request: {     tenantId: string;     pluginId: string;     operation: StorageOperation;     keys: readonly string[]; }) => boolean \| Promise<boolean>` | Yes | Invoked before each operation with trusted scope, operation, and frozen relative keys (list receives its prefix); only exactly true allows access. Errors propagate. |
| `maxUrlLifetimeSeconds` | `number` | No | Signed URLs remain usable until expiry; default ceiling 300 seconds. |

### Returns

Type declaration; no runtime value.

### Public members

#### `tenantId`

Trusted tenant ID: 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting alphanumeric. It must come from verified server identity/configuration, never request body keys.


#### `pluginId`

Trusted plugin ID: 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.


#### `authorize`

Invoked before each operation with trusted scope, operation, and frozen relative keys (list receives its prefix); only exactly true allows access. Errors propagate.


#### `authorize.request.tenantId`

Trusted tenant scope captured at adapter construction, independent of caller object keys.


#### `authorize.request.pluginId`

Trusted plugin scope captured at adapter construction.


#### `authorize.request.operation`

Storage operation about to be delegated to the provider.


#### `authorize.request.keys`

Frozen relative-key array; copy/move supplies source then destination, and list supplies its requested prefix.


#### `maxUrlLifetimeSeconds`

Signed URLs remain usable until expiry; default ceiling 300 seconds.
